report.summary: All five UI failures are page-load timeouts at 5 s on /books, where the server takes too long to render the list. The likely cause is the seeded slow_list bug in app/main.py:160-161, which adds a random 0-8 s delay to every book listing, but nothing in the repo or workflow sets BUGS, so that is unconfirmed. First, check whether BUGS=slow_list was set in the failing environment, and if so fix or remove the delay before rerunning; if it was not set, investigate the server on that machine as infrastructure.

causes.title: GET /books intermittently takes longer than the 5 s test timeout
causes.explanation: Every failing test waits on a /books page load, either directly through page.goto('/books') or as the redirect target after a POST (add book, log in). The timeouts occur while the navigation is pending, which means the server did not answer /books within 5 s. The app's list_books() sleeps for random.uniform(0, 8) seconds when the slow_list bug is enabled, so about 3/8 of listings exceed the limit. Two other /books-loading tests passed in the same run (test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf and test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui), which fits a random delay. The conftest comment says nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s, so the timeout is a valid expectation. Confidence is medium because BUGS is not set anywhere in the repo or the CI workflow, so the delay is only confirmed if it was enabled in the failing environment.
evidence: tests\ui\test_books_ui.py:13 books.add(...) -> Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded; log shows 'click action done' then 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish', i.e. the POST succeeded and the redirect to /books was slow
Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:49708/books", waiting until "load" (test_deleted_book_disappears, tests\ui\test_books_ui.py:31)
Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded navigating to /books (test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input, tests\ui\test_books_ui.py:39)
Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded navigating to /books (test_log_out_ends_the_session, tests\ui\test_login_ui.py:37)
Locator.click on get_by_test_id("submit") then 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish' (test_existing_user_can_log_in, tests\ui\test_login_ui.py:18); the post-login redirect goes to /books
app/main.py:159-161: def list_books(user_id): if "slow_list" in BUGS: time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))
app/main.py:264-270: render_books() calls list_books() on every /books render, so the delay applies to every page load and redirect target
tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7: fail_fast sets page.set_default_timeout(5000) with the docstring 'Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s'
app/main.py:31: BUGS is read from the environment; no BUGS setting appears in .github/workflows/tests.yml or any other repo file (search_code found only app/main.py)
causes.suggested_fix: Confirm whether BUGS=slow_list was set for this run (check the job environment). If the delay is not meant to be in the test target, unset it. If the slow listing is the defect under test, keep it out of the default test run and mark the affected tests as known-bad, or fix list_books so /books responds well under 5 s. Do not raise the timeout to hide it.
